posts.title: Snowball Quilt Block Tutorial
posts.description: Learn how to make a snowball quilt block in any custom size you desire. This versatile shape can be used as a standalone block, as a spacer block, or to spice up a quilt design.

posts.title: The Far Woods Bird Pattern
posts.description: As soon as I first saw this pattern by The Far Woods I knew I wanted to make a bird with my daughter. Of course each bird got a quilt as well!

posts.title: Natural Dyeing with Rudbeckia Flowers
posts.description: I grew four different varieties of Rudbeckia! In this post I share the natural dye colors I achieved with each of them.
